各自的额度窗口，一眼看清。

Track tokens, costs and balances separately.

GaoCiYuan: A record of every successful update.

GaoCiYuan: Your AI accounts in one place.

GaoCiYuan: Log real outcomes and build your own sky.

将移除该账户在本机的快照和密钥，不影响平台上的账号。需要保留记录时可先导出备份。
GaoCiYuan: This removes the local snapshots and credential. Your platform account stays intact. Export a backup to keep your records.

搞词元: 费用按账户、币种独立核算
GaoCiYuan: Costs kept separate by account and currency

搞词元: 低额度、预算提醒或同步异常
GaoCiYuan: Low quotas, budgets or sync errors

搞词元: 来源与更新时间始终可见
GaoCiYuan: Source and update time always visible

GaoCiYuan: Membership percentages, API tokens and balances are different measures. Missing values appear as “—”. Snapshots over 15 minutes old are marked stale.

搞词元: 连接本机 Codex，查看会员剩余额度；\n添加 API 账户，跟踪用量、余额与费用。
GaoCiYuan: Connect local Codex for membership quotas.\nAdd API accounts to track usage, balances and costs.

搞词元: 自动报告按 UTC 自然月统计。各账户独立展示，避免同一组织多个密钥重复汇总；预算是本机提醒，不会限制平台扣费。
GaoCiYuan: Automatic reports use UTC calendar months. Accounts stay separate to avoid double counting shared organizations. Budgets are local reminders and do not cap platform charges.

搞词元: 从官方页面录入实际额度或账单。
GaoCiYuan: Enter actual quotas or costs from the official dashboard.

搞词元: 连接后读取真实数据，不预填额度。
GaoCiYuan: Connect to read actual data. Quotas are never prefilled.

搞词元: 11 个平台 · 会员与 API 独立接入
GaoCiYuan: 11 platforms · Separate membership and API connections

搞词元: 自动接入能力因平台而异。通用快照文件可由你已有的脚本持续更新；应用定时读取，不采集聊天内容。
GaoCiYuan: Automatic support varies by platform. Your own scripts can update standard snapshot files for periodic reading. Chat content is not collected.

搞词元: 记录的是时点快照，累计月度用量不能跨快照相加。
GaoCiYuan: These are point-in-time snapshots. Do not add cumulative monthly totals across snapshots.

GaoCiYuan: Successful syncs and manual entries appear here.

GaoCiYuan: Requires an organization Admin Key. Inference keys cannot read organization billing. Credentials stay in macOS Keychain.

搞词元: 使用对应套餐或云平台的查询凭据；云余额接口需要财务只读权限，普通模型 Key 不适用。密钥仅保存在本机钥匙串。
GaoCiYuan: Use the matching plan or cloud credentials. Cloud balances require billing read permissions, not inference keys. Secrets stay in Keychain.

搞词元: 读取标准 JSON 快照，不是任意平台原始账单。格式示例见设置页，可由外部脚本持续更新。
GaoCiYuan: Reads the standard JSON snapshot format. See Settings for an example. External scripts can keep this file updated.

搞词元: 复用本机 Codex 已登录的会员账号，通过官方服务读取所有额度池。不读取聊天、不发起模型调用。多个本机 Codex 账户指向同一登录态。
GaoCiYuan: Uses your existing local Codex login and official service to read quota pools. No chats or inference calls. Multiple local Codex entries share the same login.

搞词元: 按官方页面实际数值填写；空白表示未知。手动记录会标注来源，下次自动同步可能覆盖此快照。
GaoCiYuan: Enter values from the official dashboard. Blank means unknown. Manual entries are labeled and may be replaced by the next sync.

搞词元: 提醒阈值按剩余 % 让总览、菜单栏、浮动条与小组件变色；系统通知按下方「额度告警阈值」的已用 % 档位另算。关闭应用后停止同步。手动账户不会被自动更新。
GaoCiYuan: This threshold recolors the overview, menu bar, floating bar and widgets by remaining %; system notifications use the used-% steps under "Quota alert threshold" below. Quitting stops sync. Manual accounts are never updated automatically.

搞词元: 自动查找已安装的 Codex
完整数据包含账户、历史、外观与语言设置，以及数据目录中的全部 PDF 和其他文档。API 密钥保留在钥匙串，不随备份导出。
GaoCiYuan: Full exports include accounts, history, appearance, language, and all PDFs and documents in the data folder. Secrets remain in Keychain and are not exported.

搞词元: 所有平台均可连接标准 JSON 快照。外部脚本更新文件后，应用会定时读取；observedAt 表示实际观测时间，不能用刷新时间冒充。
GaoCiYuan: All platforms support standard JSON snapshots. Files are read periodically. observedAt must reflect the actual observation time, not the time the file was read.

搞词元: 会员限额并非固定 Token 数；官方账单可能延迟。通用快照不代表所有平台已实现自动登录。自动接口均只读取，不调用模型、不充值、不修改订阅。
GaoCiYuan: Membership quotas are not fixed token amounts. Official billing may lag. File support does not mean automatic platform login. Connectors only read; they do not run models, top up or change subscriptions.

搞词元: 添加账户，随时查看剩余额度。
GaoCiYuan: Add an account to see remaining quotas.

搞词元: 同步失败，打开主窗口查看
GaoCiYuan: Sync failed. Open the main window for details.

搞词元: 重置时间已到，等待新数据
GaoCiYuan: Reset time passed; awaiting new data

搞词元: 额度比例不等同于固定 Token 余额；保留官方独立额度池。
GaoCiYuan: Quota percentages are not fixed token balances. Official quota pools remain separate.

搞词元: 请等待当前同步完成后再导入。
GaoCiYuan: Wait for the current sync to finish before importing.

搞词元: 导出成功：账户、历史、设置和数据目录内的全部文档已打包。密钥仍保留在钥匙串。
GaoCiYuan: Exported accounts, history, settings and all documents in the data folder. Credentials remain in Keychain.

搞词元: 导入完成，原数据及所有文档均已保留。请检查账户连接后再开启自动同步。
GaoCiYuan: Import complete. Original data and documents were preserved. Check connections before enabling automatic sync.

搞词元: 平台响应格式不符，保留上次数据；请检查接口或升级连接器。
GaoCiYuan: Unexpected platform response. Previous data was retained; check the API or update the connector.

搞词元: 网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试。
GaoCiYuan: Connection failed. Check your network and retry.

搞词元: 请填写有效的 Team ID 或 AccessKey ID。
GaoCiYuan: Enter a valid Team ID or AccessKey ID.

搞词元: Codex 可读取本机会员额度；API 用量和费用需组织 Admin Key。ChatGPT 聊天额度与 Codex 额度分别计算。
GaoCiYuan: Local Codex reads membership quota pools. API reports require an organization Admin Key. ChatGPT chat limits and Codex limits are separate.

搞词元: API 用量与费用需组织 Admin Key；Pro / Max 会员额度可从官方用量页录入或通过快照文件同步。
GaoCiYuan: API reports require an organization Admin Key. Enter Pro / Max membership quotas from the official usage page or sync a snapshot file.

搞词元: API Key 可自动查询账户余额；Token 和消费明细通过快照文件或手动录入。
GaoCiYuan: An API key can query account balance. Use snapshots or manual entry for token and spending details.

搞词元: 国内 Moonshot API Key 可查询人民币余额；Kimi 会员与 API 账户分别记录。
GaoCiYuan: A China Moonshot API key can query CNY balance. Kimi membership and API accounts are tracked separately.

搞词元: xAI Management Key 与 Team ID 可查询本月 API 费用及预付余额；不代表 Grok 聊天会员额度。
GaoCiYuan: An xAI Management Key and Team ID can query monthly API costs and prepaid balance, not Grok chat membership quotas.

搞词元: Google AI 聊天会员尚未发现公开额度接口。API 账单需 Cloud Billing 导出至 BigQuery；本版支持标准快照同步。
GaoCiYuan: No public Google AI chat quota API was verified. API billing uses Cloud Billing exports to BigQuery; this version supports standard snapshot files.

搞词元: 阿里云 AccessKey 可查询云账户现金余额，覆盖该云账号所有产品，不是百炼独占余额；聊天会员、Token 与费用可用快照同步。
GaoCiYuan: Alibaba Cloud AccessKeys can query account-wide cash balance, not a Model Studio exclusive balance. Use snapshots for chat quotas, tokens and costs.

搞词元: 火山引擎 AccessKey 可查询云账号可用余额，覆盖该账号所有产品，不是豆包会员额度或方舟独占余额。
GaoCiYuan: Volcengine AccessKeys can query account-wide available balance, not Doubao membership or an Ark exclusive balance.

搞词元: 使用 GLM Coding Plan Key，按智谱官方插件读取套餐额度；按量 API 与聊天会员另行记录。
GaoCiYuan: Use a GLM Coding Plan key to read quotas through the official plugin's endpoint. Track pay-as-you-go API and chat membership separately.

搞词元: 使用 Token Plan 专用 Key 查询模型额度窗口；支持国内与国际站。按量余额与聊天会员不在此接口内。
GaoCiYuan: Use a Token Plan key to query model quota windows in China or internationally. This endpoint excludes pay-as-you-go balances and chat memberships.

搞词元: 尚未核实公开的余额或会员额度接口；支持标准快照及手动录入，不使用网页登录 Cookie。
GaoCiYuan: No public balance or membership quota API was verified. Standard snapshots and manual entry are supported, without browser cookies.

搞词元: GLM 官方 Coding Plan 接口
MiniMax 官方 Token Plan API
火山引擎官方 Billing API
余额不代表累计消费；此接口不提供 Token 用量。
GaoCiYuan: Balance is not cumulative spending. This endpoint does not report token usage.

搞词元: 余额包含有效赠金与充值余额；此接口不提供 Token 和累计费用。
GaoCiYuan: Balance includes valid promotional and prepaid credits. This endpoint does not report tokens or cumulative costs.

搞词元: UTC 本月组织级报告；Token 为 completions 类别，费用来自独立 Costs 报告。缓存输入不重复累加。
GaoCiYuan: Current UTC month, organization-wide. Tokens cover completions; costs come from the separate Costs report. Cached input is not double counted.

搞词元: UTC 本月组织级报告；含缓存读写，Priority Tier 费用不在官方成本接口内。
GaoCiYuan: Current UTC month, organization-wide. Includes cache reads and writes. The official cost endpoint excludes Priority Tier costs.

搞词元: UTC 本月团队 API 费用及预付余额；不含 Grok 会员额度，接口未提供本次查询的 Token 总数。
GaoCiYuan: Current UTC month team API costs and prepaid balance. Excludes Grok membership quotas and does not report token totals for this query.

搞词元: 优先采用官方剩余百分比；旧字段按官方 CLI 兼容规则解析。额度单位随模型而异，不换算为固定 Token。
GaoCiYuan: Official remaining percentages take priority. Legacy fields follow the official CLI convention. Units vary by model and are not converted to fixed tokens.

搞词元: 使用智谱官方额度查询插件相同的只读端点；百分比为已用比例，未猜测重置时间。
GaoCiYuan: Uses the same read-only endpoint as Zhipu's official quota plugin. Percentages represent usage. Reset times are not guessed.

搞词元: 整个阿里云账号的现金余额，包含其他云产品；不是 Qwen 独占额度，不包含授信额度。
GaoCiYuan: Cash balance across the Alibaba Cloud account, including other products. Not a Qwen-exclusive quota; excludes credit limits.

搞词元: 火山引擎国内云账号可用余额，可能包含授信并扣除冻结款；不是豆包会员或方舟独占额度。
GaoCiYuan: China Volcengine account-wide available balance, which may include credit and deduct frozen funds. Not a Doubao or Ark-exclusive quota.

搞词元: Codex 读取超时或服务退出。请确认已登录且网络可用。
GaoCiYuan: Codex timed out or exited. Check your login and network.

搞词元: Codex 额度读取失败。请在 Codex 中登录会员账号后重试。
GaoCiYuan: Could not read Codex quotas. Sign into a membership account in Codex and retry.

搞词元: 未找到 Codex。请安装并登录 Codex，或在设置中选择可执行文件。
GaoCiYuan: Codex was not found. Install and sign in, or select its executable in Settings.

搞词元: 该账号未返回可用额度窗口。API Key 登录不能读取会员额度。
GaoCiYuan: The account returned no quota windows. API key logins cannot read membership quotas.

搞词元: 请在账户设置中保存 API 密钥。
GaoCiYuan: Save a credential in account settings.

搞词元: 平台未返回有效套餐额度，请确认使用 Token Plan 专用密钥。
GaoCiYuan: No valid plan quotas returned. Check that you are using a Token Plan key.

GaoCiYuan: Tokens and costs require a reporting start and end time.

备份文件校验失败，未导入任何数据。
GaoCiYuan: Backup checksum failed. Nothing was imported.

GaoCiYuan: Snapshot files must not exceed 2 MB.

GaoCiYuan: Data contains symbolic links. Copy the actual files into the data folder first.

搞词元: 数据目录不是有效的普通目录。
GaoCiYuan: The data path is not a valid regular folder.

GaoCiYuan: The data folder contains unsupported special files.
Unable to read the data folder.

GaoCiYuan: Insufficient permission; admin endpoints require an organization Admin Key

GaoCiYuan: The reporting start time must not be later than its end.

搞词元: 请先恢复可用的数据备份。
GaoCiYuan: Restore a valid data backup first.

GaoCiYuan: Save the backup outside the application data folder.

GaoCiYuan: Enter at least one quota window.

GaoCiYuan: Enter at least one actual usage or monetary value.

请选择快照 JSON 文件。

GaoCiYuan: Enter a valid number for the amount.

GaoCiYuan: Enter a budget greater than zero.

搞词元: 额度名称不能为空，剩余比例必须在 0–100 之间。
GaoCiYuan: Quota names are required and remaining percentages must be between 0 and 100.

搞词元: 自动读取本机官方用量页（含免费额度）
GaoCiYuan: Read local official usage pages automatically (including free plans)

搞词元: 支持 Chrome、Edge、Safari 及可访问的客户端页面。仅读取官方用量页中明确显示的百分比；登录本身不代表平台公开剩余额度。当前标签页之外的网页及未显示的数值无法读取。
GaoCiYuan: Supports Chrome, Edge, Safari and accessible client pages. Reads explicit percentages on official usage pages. Login alone does not expose quotas. Other tabs and values not shown on the page cannot be read.

搞词元: 等待系统授权，尚未开始读取
GaoCiYuan: Waiting for system permission; reading has not started

搞词元: 已发现官方页面；登录与剩余额度尚未确认
GaoCiYuan: Official page detected; login and remaining quota not confirmed

搞词元: 已发现客户端；尚未显示可读取的官方用量页
GaoCiYuan: Client detected; no readable official usage page is visible

GaoCiYuan: From the accessible official usage page, which may be cached. No credentials are read or reset times guessed. This record represents the current browser page and does not distinguish logins within the same browser.

搞词元: 请在官方用量页显示额度，应用会在获授权后自动读取。
GaoCiYuan: Show quotas on the official usage page. The app reads them automatically once permission is granted.

搞词元: 这是 macOS WidgetKit 小组件。请在桌面或通知中心进入“编辑小组件”，搜索“搞词元”，可添加小号、中号或大号额度总览。退出主应用后仍会保留最近一次同步结果。
GaoCiYuan: This is a macOS WidgetKit widget. Choose Edit Widgets on the desktop or in Notification Center, search for GaoCiYuan, and add the small, medium, or large overview. The latest synced result remains visible after the main app quits.

搞词元: 小组件数据写入失败，请重新打开应用后再试。
GaoCiYuan: Could not write widget data. Reopen the app and try again.

GaoCiYuan: The widget contains account names and usage summaries only. It never contains API keys, cookies, or chat content.

搞词元: 各 Agent（如 Codex、Antigravity 等）的额度监控由该 Agent 在其自身运行环境中自动操作接入，无需在此手动添加。例如当前监视的 Codex 与 Antigravity 均由其自身自动配置添加。此处仅供手动添加 LLM (API) 账户。
GaoCiYuan: Agent quota monitoring is configured and added automatically by each agent (such as Codex, Antigravity, etc.) within its own runtime environment, and does not require manual addition here. For example, Codex and Antigravity monitoring are added automatically by themselves. This interface is only for manually adding LLM (API) accounts.

搞词元: 12 个平台 · LLM 官方接入
Agent 由各 Agent 自身自动化接入；LLM 对接官方 API。支持通用快照文件同步，不采集聊天正文。
GaoCiYuan: Agents are connected automatically by themselves; LLM connects via official APIs. Supports standard JSON snapshot files without collecting chat text.

暂无已接入的 Agent 账户
Agent 额度监控由各 Agent 在其自身运行环境中自动配置接入，无需手动添加。
GaoCiYuan: Agent quota monitoring is automatically configured and added by each agent in its own runtime environment; no manual addition required.

搞词元: Kimi Code 官方额度 API
使用 Kimi Code 订阅专用 Key（kimi.com 控制台获取，通常 sk-kimi- 开头），与 Moonshot 开放平台按量 Key 互不通用。密钥仅保存在本机钥匙串。
GaoCiYuan: Use a Kimi Code subscription key (from the kimi.com console, usually starting with sk-kimi-). It is not interchangeable with Moonshot Open Platform pay-as-you-go keys. Secrets stay in macOS Keychain.

搞词元: Agent（Kimi Work / Kimi Code）：保存 Kimi Code 专用 Key 后自动读取官方额度，或经辅助功能只读读取本机 Kimi 桌面端订阅页（月度额度池，无需 Key），否则检测本机软件状态；LLM（API）支持 Moonshot Key 查询人民币余额与 Kimi Code 额度。
